objects.description: [Carberp](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0484) has exploited multiple Windows vulnerabilities (CVE-2010-2743, CVE-2010-3338, CVE-2010-4398, CVE-2008-1084) and a .NET Runtime Optimization vulnerability for privilege escalation.(Citation: ESET Carberp March 2012)(Citation: Prevx Carberp March 2011)
